title: ForgeRequest (stdin of `python -m fpengine forge`)
description: Normative. contracts.md section 4. This schema checks structure only: a request that does not match it is answered with bad_request. Value ranges (weight 1..1000, scale 0.1..10, base_index and rule indexes in range, non-empty names) are checked by the engine's ForgeSpec.validate() and answered with `validate`. Unknown keys are ignored; missing optional keys take the defaults given here (reference engine/spec.py:24-31).

materials.description: Priority order; index 0 is the highest priority.

expect.description: What the caller scanned. When present and the file's size, mtime (|delta| > 1e-3 s) or PostScript name differ, the forge fails with stale_material.

script_rules.description: Group id -> material index, or null for no rule. Default {}.

output_path.description: Where the finished font goes. It is written atomically: the file appears only when the forge succeeds.
